svg.title: Neon vs Prisma Postgres when you want hosting and the database in one place
svg.desc: Two stacks side by side: Neon as a database next to a separate host, and Prisma with the app and database inside one project. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: What to compare when the app
